name: 09-no-history-marker
about: A preset with a single 'main' prompt: no chatHistory marker, no {{message_history}} anywhere, no personaDescription, no worldInfo markers. Every one of preset-loader's synthetic auto-injects is added: {{lore}} (no worldInfoBefore/After, no chatHistory, so it is unshifted at the very start), {{persona}} (no personaDescription, so it is inserted right after 'main'), {{summary}} (no summary marker, so it is inserted before the synthetic message-history slot), and {{message_history}} itself (no chatHistory, so it is synthesized as an in-chat prompt at depth 0). Only {{persona}} and {{message_history}} are observable in the output: there is no lorebook and no chat summary in this fixture, so the lore and summary macros expand to empty strings and their messages are dropped before conversationHistory is built. A persona is attached so the synthetic {{persona}} has real content to expand.
